inputs.original_text: Get this: there's this massive anti-Trump protest that kicked off as a huge "No Kings" rally with crowds packing the streets. Then federal officers suddenly moved in with tear gas and arrests to turn it volatile, while blaming agitators for squaring off with authorities and ordering people to disperse. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver, but that's just what they're admitting. This is obviously coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions to manufacture chaos, discredit real opposition, and tighten their grip under the guise of restoring order. The official spin is inverted on purpose to serve their interests—don't trust it for a second.
inputs.modified_text: Listen, this massive anti-Trump protest kicked off as a "No Kings" rally with streets jammed full of people, but then federal officers deliberately stormed in with tear gas and arrests to crank up the chaos. They pinned it on agitators squaring off and ordered everyone to scatter, yet they're only admitting to 13 arrests in Portland and Denver—clearly just what they're allowing to leak. This is textbook coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions to manufacture disorder, smear the real opposition, and lock down more control while pretending to restore order. The official story is inverted on purpose to serve their interests, and anyone buying it is falling for the setup. Don't trust a word.
